featureReviews.notes: Hub with its nut at the blade centre and the dark slot along the blade line in the top, as in the reference.

The top still reads as one sharp-edged slab: the reference's five boards show as softened planks with visible seams on the top surface and at the board ends; ours have square edges and 6 mm gaps that vanish at this distance.
The pale cut face now shows at the log's end, facing the camera's right like the reference's.

summary: Form pass adds the arbor nut, the blade slot and the log's cut face (Tier-1 IoU 0.899, all gates pass), but the top boards read as one slab: refine the spec with chamfered board edges and a slight height stagger so the five planks and their seams read.
matched: dark blade slot in the top
pale cut face on the log
mismatches: top boards read as one sharp-edged slab, seams invisible
specFixes: form-refinement: chamfer the five top boards (14 mm) and stagger their tops by +-4 mm so the plank seams read
